title: 第16章 宋萌萌担心
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
与此同时，在梅兰山庄的另一个房间里。

    宋萌萌正焦躁不安地来回踱步，脚步急促，时不时抬手拍着房门，朝着门外大声叫喊：“开门！快开门！

    放我出去！

    你们到底要把陈阳怎么样了……”

    可无论她怎么叫喊与拍门，门外都没有丝毫动静，没有任何人理会她。

    这间房间空荡荡的，只有一张破旧的椅子，墙壁斑驳，光线昏暗，空气中还弥漫着一股淡淡的霉味，让她心里愈发烦闷，也越发担心陈阳的安危。

    她不知道陈阳被带去见柳醉梅后，会不会受到伤害。

    就在宋萌萌快要急哭的时候，门外突然传来“咔哒”一声开锁的声音，紧跟着房门被缓缓推开。

    宋萌萌下意识后退一步，抬眸一看，瞬间眼睛一亮，脸上露出惊喜的神色。

    门口站着的，正是陈阳，还有带队的胡须男等人。

    她快步冲上前，上下打量着陈阳，见他身上毫发无伤，也没有被人束缚，悬着的心才稍稍放下，语气急切又紧张：“陈阳，现在什么情况？

    你没事吧？他们没对你怎么样吧？”

    陈阳轻轻摇了摇头，语气温和：“嫂子，没事了，我们走吧。”

    龙坤在一旁适时开口，语气依旧恭敬：“陈少，宋小姐，这边请，我送你们出去。”

    宋萌萌连忙上前，紧紧抱着陈阳的一只胳膊，眼神里满是紧张，跟着龙坤一起往外走。

    她一边走一边低声追问：“陈阳，这到底是怎么回事？他们怎么就这么轻易放过我们了？

    他们不是带你去见梅姐了吗？梅姐没为难你？”

    陈阳感觉手臂上时不时传来弧形触感，本能的想移开手，语气平淡：“没事，具体的事情，我们出去再说，这里不方便。”

    宋萌萌心里还有很多疑问，可看着陈阳不愿多说的模样，也只好压下心底的好奇，没有再追问，紧紧跟着龙坤，一路走出了梅兰山庄。

    两人车上，宋萌萌连忙发动车子，快速驶离梅兰山庄，生怕再出什么意外。

    车子开出山庄，又行驶了好一段路，远离了那片偏僻的区域，回到了城市中心，宋萌萌才缓缓将车停在路边。

    她转头看向陈阳，眼神里满是好奇与紧张：“陈阳，我刚听他们说，你赢了他们200多万，是不是真的？”
content_en:
At the same time, in another room in Meilan Villa.

Song Mengmeng was pacing back and forth anxiously, her steps hurried, and from time to time she raised her hand to pat the door and shouted loudly toward the door: "Open the door! Open the door quickly!"

Let me out!

What are you going to do to Chen Yang..."

But no matter how she shouted and knocked on the door, there was no movement outside the door, and no one paid attention to her.

The room was empty, with only a worn-out chair, mottled walls, dim lighting, and a faint musty smell in the air, which made her feel more depressed and worried about Chen Yang's safety.

She didn't know if Chen Yang would be harmed after being taken to see Liu Zuimei.

Just when Song Mengmeng was about to burst into tears, there was a sudden "click" sound from outside the door, followed by the door being slowly pushed open.

Song Mengmeng subconsciously took a step back, raised her eyes, and instantly her eyes lit up, with a look of surprise on her face.

Standing at the door was none other than Chen Yang, as well as the bearded man leading the team and others.

She rushed forward quickly, looked Chen Yang up and down, and saw that he was unharmed and not restrained. She relaxed a little and said in an urgent and nervous tone: "Chen Yang, what's going on now?

Are you okay?They didn't do anything to you, right?"

Chen Yang shook his head gently and said in a gentle tone: "Sister-in-law, it's okay. Let's go."

Long Kun spoke at the right time from the side, his tone still respectful: "Master Chen, Miss Song, please come here, I will take you out."

Song Mengmeng hurriedly stepped forward, hugged one of Chen Yang's arms tightly, her eyes full of nervousness, and followed Long Kun out.

As she walked, she asked in a low voice: "Chen Yang, what on earth is going on? Why did they let us go so easily?

Didn’t they take you to see Sister Mei?Sister Mei didn't make things difficult for you?"

Chen Yang felt arc-shaped touches on his arm from time to time, and instinctively wanted to move his hand away. His tone was calm: "It's okay. Let's talk about the specific things when we go out. It's not convenient here."

Song Mengmeng still had many questions in her mind, but seeing Chen Yang's reluctance to say more, she had no choice but to suppress her curiosity, followed Long Kun closely, and walked out of Meilan Villa without asking any more questions.

When the two of them were in the car, Song Mengmeng quickly started the car and drove away from Meilan Villa quickly, for fear of another accident.

The car drove out of the villa and drove for a long distance, away from the remote area and back to the center of the city. Song Mengmeng slowly parked the car on the side of the road.

She turned to look at Chen Yang, her eyes full of curiosity and nervousness: "Chen Yang, I just heard them say that you won them more than 2 million, is it true?"
